decision: Permit narrowly vendored/patched saphyr-parser0.1.0 with explicit scanner/reader profile, shared by default and Python serialization paths. Do not retain a heuristic global NEL replacement or blanket block rejection.

evidence.nativeReader: ruamel Reader.forward1.2 increments column for rawNEL/LS/PS without resettingline; Scanner.scan_line_break classifies NEL/LS/PS asbreaks, mappingNELtoLF and retainingLS/PS. This is observably context-dependent.
evidence.publicUpstreamApi: Input can override lookahead/classifiers, but scanner Marker and skip_nl are private, unconditional LF-style line/column reset; read_break always emitsLF. Existing API cannot model the required nativeprofile solely through input rewriting.

interface.concept: Explicit immutable ScanProfile::{Yaml12,PythonRuamel12} passed by trusted host code through Parser string constructor to the same Input/Scanner implementation. Existing Parser constructors retain Yaml12 default.
interface.integration: yaml_events/prepare_yaml_events accept an explicit profile selected by the Rust source/value adapter, never source document text. Both profiles use same scanner/parser/event/span implementation and generic value assembly.
interface.internalFlexibility: Private method names/layout may evolve, but all raw-read, bulk-read, whitespace/comment, document-indicator, break classification, marker advance, and scalar folding paths must honor one consistent selected profile.

implementationConstraints: Vendor exact pinned0.1.0 source with upstream identity/checksum and focused patch explanation. Retain both copyright owners and all required MIT/Apache license texts, including hidden .licenses content referenced by LICENSE.

Place vendored source beneath an already attested production crate or explicitly extend native/compiler/source-build closure; Cargo path/patch must make every production native/WASM target use the same patched dependency.
Preserve default profile behavior and predecessor11compiler artifacts modulo exact generated provenance.

Implement native NEL/LS/PS scanner and column semantics, including comments, plain/quoted/flow/block scalar contexts. Match independently frozen observations; no candidate-driven changes to oracle files.
Keep timestamp tag/key decision before value flattening; quoteddatekeys admitted, implicit timestamp keys rejected, timestamp values retained as strings.
No global source normalization that changes token/indentation structure, no new restrictive subset, no separate Python YAML scanner/parser copy.

No entropy/environment/network access introduced. Existing input4MUTF16, depth/value, event admission and cooperative precharges/cancel/deadline remain. Additional variable work/copies must be admitted before allocation; avoid unbounded source expansion.
Source distribution must include all patched parser sources/licenses and build with no JavaScript tools/offline cache; native and realWASM require fresh execution.
qualification: Original139, all Python372+60+852+588+522 observations, with only separately guarded approved NEL writer correction.
Add production scanner-profile unit tests that verify defaultYaml12 unchanged and nativePython lexical distinctions without relying only on copied fixtures.
Final source/dependency/license review and exact source/binary receipts before overallR2 approval.
